scientific_integrity: Exact group-orbit reduction and global derivative inequalities establish all assertions; deterministic quadrature and random sampling corroborate but do not constitute proof.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean intrinsic metric on compact flat Klein bottles, area-uniform independent pairs; exact general CDF is a one-dimensional integral; only mean-square energy has a proved unique fixed-area minimizer; no claim of stochastic optimality, complete historical priority, or independent validation.
title: Sharp mean-square geodesic distance on flat Klein bottles
